text:
Maya (CS): FYIStratus reserved pool bring-up: quota OK for 10 GPUs (temporary), customer asked for 95th < 150ms and tail mitigation. Need a plan for warmup, chaos rehearsal, and final acceptance sign-off.
Omar (Infra): II'll take warmup. Plan: 12h prefix warming + token-distribution priming. Running `scripts/pool_prime.py --pool stratus --mode=prefix --duration=12h`. Will also seed KV store with 100k keys.
Chris (SRE): II'll handle chaos rehearsal and SLO ops. Proposal: run two failure scenarios during ramp: 1) single GPU OOM (>80% mem) 2) network partition at rack level. We'll have automated traffic-shift to hosted at 40% error spike.
Priya (PE): I'll coordinate acceptance tests with the customer. Need to verify auth/TLS, KMS policies, and end-to-end prompt regression. Also want to run a small A/B sample vs hosted for quality diffs.
Maya (CS): Good. Quick asks: - can we shorten cooldowns during ramp to allow faster scale? - how will we measure prompt quality drift? Also renewal touchpoint: positive soak means higher chance they renew early; negative soak -> escalations.
Omar (Infra): Cooldown change: set cooldown to 60s for ramp window only, reverting to 180s after soak. Autoscale: min=4, initial=6 (we'll bootstrap to initial), max=14. I'll push policy to `infra/policies/stratus-autoscale.yaml`.
Chris (SRE): Monitoring checks I'll add:
- `p95_chat_latency > 150ms` for 5m -> alert (pager optional)
- `tail_error_rate > 0.3%` for 2m -> sev2
- `host_cpu_steal > 10%` for 3m -> infra notify
I'll create a short runbook snippet for rollback and attach the grafana panel.
status-bot: Canary job scheduled: `canary/stratus/soak-1` starts at 2026-05-21T18:00:00Z (job id 7892).
Priya (PE): For prompt quality drift we'll run: 500 sample prompts (mix of short/long), measure top-k ROUGE + semantic similarity (embedding cosine). If mean cosine drops > 0.02 versus baseline, flag for manual review. I'll upload baseline vectors to `s3://redwood-evals/stratus/baseline-v1.json`.
Maya (CS): Can we add a short customer-facing note about fallback behavior? They want guaranteed fallback within 90s of detected degradation.
Omar (Infra): Yes. Fallback orchestration will be automated via routing service. Example API call: 
```
POST /v1/route/switch
{"from":"stratus-pool","to":"hosted-fallback","timeout_s":90}
```
We'll also attach a throttle bucket to limit request spikes during failover.
Chris (SRE): Chaos rehearsal note: we'll induce a 30s GPU reboot during ramp to validate stateful reconnection and KV cache warm-up. If reconnection > 60s, we trigger fallback.
Priya (PE): Customer sign-off items checklist:
- priming log (link)
- sample prompt pack & baseline diffs
- acceptance run results (latency + errors)
- KMS verification
I will collect signatures by Thu EOD PST.
Maya (CS): Action list: Omar: run prime + post logs; Chris: add alerts + attach runbook; Priya: deliver prompts + review results; Maya: draft renewal note and update account exec.
Omar (Infra): Started priming job (job id 5621). Will paste progress logs here when 10%/50%/100% milestones hit.
status-bot: Priming job 5621 progress: 10% (seeded 10k keys)
Chris (SRE): Confirmed; I'll post the runbook link and grafana by EOD UTC.
Priya (PE): Prompt pack uploaded to customer share: https://redwood.share/stratus/prompts_v1.zip
Maya (CS): Thanks. If any of the acceptance metrics fail during soak we escalate to leadership. Keeping thread open for updates. :eyes:
